paintcraft.configuration.title: PaintCraft Settings
Maximum distance (in blocks) at which decals are rendered.
paintcraft.configuration.atlasSize.toolt: Texture atlas resolution for decal rendering. Higher values support more decals but use more VRAM. Requires game restart.
paintcraft.configuration.ghostPreviewOpa: Opacity of the stamp placement preview (0 = invisible, 255 = fully opaque).
paintcraft.configuration.maxBrushSize.to: Maximum brush size in pixels (controlled by scroll wheel in the editor).
Maximum number of undo steps in the paint editor.
paintcraft.configuration.depthBias.toolt: Clip-space depth bias that keeps decals in front of block surfaces (prevents Z-fighting) at all distances, without moving geometry. Increase if decals flicker; decrease if they wrongly cover geometry in front of them.
paintcraft.configuration.maxDecalsPerChu: Maximum number of decals allowed per chunk. Lower values reduce storage and network overhead.
paintcraft.configuration.maxPlacementDis: Maximum distance (in blocks) a player can be from a decal to place, edit, or erase it.
paintcraft.configuration.maxCanvasSize.t: Maximum canvas dimension in blocks (width and height).
paintcraft.configuration.maxDepth.toolti: Maximum projection depth in blocks. Controls how far decals can wrap into recessed geometry.
paintcraft.configuration.opPermissionLev: Server operator permission level required to bypass decal ownership checks.
